label: Bible Study
prompt: And Simon answering said unto him, Master, we have toiled all the night, and have taken nothing: nevertheless at thy word I will let down the _____.
verse: And Simon answering said unto him, Master, we have toiled all the night, and have taken nothing: nevertheless at thy word I will let down the net.
note: Peter's tired reply after a fruitless night — the catch that followed nearly sank two boats.

label: Warm-Up Word
note: Four little words open the last chapter of Hebrews: keep the brotherly love going.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And he looked up, and said, I see men as _____, walking.
verse: And he looked up, and said, I see men as trees, walking.
note: A healing in two stages: after the first touch, the blind man of Bethsaida saw men like walking trees.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Wherefore, my beloved brethren, let every man be _____ to hear, slow to speak, slow to wrath:
verse: Wherefore, my beloved brethren, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, slow to wrath:
note: James's three-part rule for every argument: fast ears, slow mouth, slower temper.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: For consider him that endured such _____ of sinners against himself, lest ye be wearied and faint in your minds.
verse: For consider him that endured such contradiction of sinners against himself, lest ye be wearied and faint in your minds.
note: When you're weary, consider Jesus, who 'endured such contradiction of sinners' — hostility — against himself.
